mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in UNRATE above 3.6% triggers a labor market tightening effect, reducing inflation expectations and prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 3.6% in the next month, yet S&P 500 20-day forward returns remain positive, or the correlation between UNRATE movement and returns is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in demand (GDPC1) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS) create a reinforcing cycle that elevates equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The co-movement between GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS does not predict positive returns, or their combined effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime characterized by high demand (GDPC1 > 19,200) and monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%), S&P 500 forward returns are positively influenced over the next 60 trading days due to sustained growth expectations.
failure_condition: The late-cycle expansion regime is not met (GDPC1 ≤ 19,200 or FEDFUNDS ≥ 2.0%), yet S&P 500 60-day forward returns remain positive, or the regime condition is met but returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above 110 signals robust supply growth, boosting corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross above 110 in the next month, yet S&P 500 5-day forward returns remain positive, or the correlation between INDPRO movement and returns is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in supply (INDPRO) and demand (GDPC1) create a virtuous cycle of economic activity, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The co-movement between INDPRO and GDPC1 does not predict positive returns, or their combined effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and GDPC1 > 19,200), lower interest rates and robust demand reduce borrowing costs and stimulate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The monetary easing cycle is not active (FEDFUNDS ≥ 2.0% or GDPC1 ≤ 19,200), yet S&P 500 20-day forward returns remain positive, or the regime condition is met but returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 3.6% over the next month triggers expectations of tighter labor markets, reducing inflation and prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises above 3.6% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 3.6% in the next month, yet S&P 500 60-day forward returns remain positive, or the correlation between UNRATE movement and returns is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).
